text:
marta: FYI payments spotted an odd refund->chargeback pattern on merchant acct `acct_9JtR` starting 2026-03-08 18:12 UTC. ~11 disputed items but 6 were refunded right before disputes.

devin: refund then dispute = risky. Any commonalities (same ip, ua, descriptor)?

marta: early peek: descriptor 'Redwood Pro - Annual', repeated IP 45.76.9.* and last4 cluster 1111/2222.

clare: tagging @fraud-bot to pull flags and rule hits. Also should we temporarily suspend refunds for that merchant until we investigate?

fraud-bot: auto: 11 CHARGEBACKS (CB01/CB90 mix), 8 unique cards, RULE_HISTORICAL_REFUND_ABUSE triggered, IP_PREFIX_REUSE. 4 of 11 had no 3DS.

devin: please pause refunds for acct_9JtR (soft block) and block card refunds where 3DS=false.

payments-bot: scheduled soft block: POST /internal/blocks {account:acct_9JtR, scope:refunds, reason:"suspected-refund-abuse"} - applied at 18:25 UTC.

clare: ops, can you export the last 120 days of settlements + refund logs for that account? PSP will want proof of refund timing vs service provision.

marta: also product - did we send pro-rated credits automatically? That might explain class of refunds. @dev-team?

devin: product confirms auto-prorate enabled for annual->monthly downgrades during promo period. That could be abused. We'll blacklist that promo for this merchant id immediately.

clare: assembling dispute packets. Need auth logs, receipt emails, proof-of-service timestamps, and refund transaction IDs. PSP requires evidence within 7 business days.

marta: PSP rep replied: "We'll accept evidence upload via our portal. If you can provide per-transaction receipts + timestamps we'll contest where appropriate."

devin: I'll run a query to join refunds->subscriptions to build timelines: `SELECT r.id, r.created_at, s.started_at, r.amount, r.method FROM refunds r JOIN subscriptions s ON s.id=r.sub_id WHERE s.account='acct_9JtR' AND r.created_at > '2026-01-01'`

clare: uploaded CSV to s3://redwood-finance/disputes/1828123456-acct_9JtR-refundlog.csv. Memo with recommended responses attached.

marta: thank you. checklist: [x] soft block refunds, [x] export uploaded, [x] promo blacklisted, [ ] evidence packet submitted to PSP, [ ] follow-up with merchant and sales. Keeping thread open until PSP outcome.
